description: Materialization (T4, R4): the claim `ready → running` is the single serialization point — and its readiness was RE-CHECKED at the attempt, against the row as it is now (D4: brief AND plan AND priority-not-unknown, never a cached verdict). This fixture is the DIRECT branch: the project has no queue rows, so the payload goes to the same loop.start door the queue's own advance ends at — one door, both ways. The other branch answers {"queued": true, "queueItemId": N, ...} instead: S24's ordering then decides WHEN the loop runs, appending starts nothing (CG4), and the item honestly sits running-until-started until it does (D6).
